subject: Life Skills
title: Talking About Money
description: A micro-lesson that makes Talking About Money usable.

hook.text: A couple fought about money every month for a year. They never once sat down to discuss their actual numbers.

buildup.text: Money is the top cause of relationship stress. The core issue is not usually math — it is unspoken expectations and.

discovery.text: A money conversation needs a schedule, not a crisis. Monthly check-ins with a preset agenda prevent fights before they.

twist.text: Partners often have different money scripts. A saver and a spender are not incompatible — they just need to see each.

climax.text: Start with values, not budgets. Ask: 'What does financial security mean to you?' Shared values make shared budgets.

punchline.text: Talk about money before it talks about you.

quiz.question: What should money conversations between partners start with?
options: Shared values and what financial security means to each person
